title: Rust DAO TX runtime wiring: drive send_dao from dao_tx_timing state via runtime_poll actions
description: Follow-up from b7z9.16.1 (state machine landed, commit 870577f9db + 2358ce17de): the runtime_poll action loop (rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/runtime.rs RplRuntimeAction {Receive, TrickleTransmit, TrickleExpire}) has no DAO TX action. Add plumbing so a joined Leaf drives DaoTimingState (dao_tx_timing.rs): on_join at DODAG join, poll next_action in runtime_poll, on_due -> send_dao() (rpl_stack/transmit.rs) then on_sent/on_ack per outcome. Wiring must consume the dao_timing oracle (no constant duplication) and keep the state machine pure (monotonic now_ms only). Tests: fake-clock runtime poll asserting initial 0-2s, 4/8/16 retries, 900s refresh. Blocked on: this host's lichen-node lib tests are blocked by oscore-fork 0.1.2/0.1.3 drift (env-only; heft or main-checkout can run them).
